title: Live bounded browser transfers
objective: Connect Quntal's existing bounded download/upload contracts to the live governed browser engine without creating generic browser filesystem access. Browser downloads stage into protected Quntal state before the existing destination/type/size/digest/approval checks; uploads remain restricted to server-recorded admissible artifacts and exact typed file-input nodes.

include: intercepted live browser downloads into protected Quntal staging with hard byte/time/count bounds

revalidation of source page/origin/generation, redirect chain, declared/actual type and size, content digest, approved workspace destination, create-only semantics, and fresh SOFT approval before workspace placement
no browser direct-write to arbitrary workspace/user paths and no auto-open/execute/extract after download
live upload staging only from server-recorded admissible artifacts under the existing upload-source confinement rules
exact live file-input node identity/role/state/page/document binding plus source digest/size/media/trust/policy revision and fresh SOFT approval
one-shot transfer source consumption, deterministic expiry, cancellation, crash cleanup, and orphan staging cleanup

tests for download auto-trigger, dangerous/unknown payloads, filename/path/reparse attacks, redirect widening, oversized/truncated content, changed artifacts, arbitrary caller paths, replaced file inputs, trust revoke, and duplicate submission
exclude: arbitrary caller-selected download roots or upload paths
workspace-authored or user-home upload sources unless separately authorized later
personal profile or browser credential stores

authority_delta.filesystem: Live browser bytes may enter protected Quntal staging; final download placement/upload reads remain constrained by the already closed bounded transfer contracts. No generic path authority is added.
authority_delta.network: Transfer network activity is constrained to SG-000075 governed browser egress and exact page/source origin policy.
authority_delta.browser: Approved live download interception and upload-to-file-input become real under existing typed transfer identities.
authority_delta.secrets: No credential/cookie/token/browser-profile material may become a transfer source or evidence payload.
authority_delta.approval: Fresh one-shot SOFT approval remains mandatory at the existing mutation points.

invariants: the browser never gains generic workspace/user filesystem authority
uploads accept only server-authorized source classes and exact file-input nodes

acceptance.claim: A real browser download is intercepted, bounded, staged, verified, approved, and placed create-only at exactly the authorized workspace destination with no direct arbitrary browser write.
A real upload submits only an admissible server-recorded artifact to one exact current file-input node after complete source/node/trust/approval revalidation.
Path/reparse, redirect, type/content, size/truncation, changed-artifact, arbitrary-source, replaced-node, trust-revoke, crash, cancellation, and duplicate/replay tests fail closed.
No generic filesystem, execution/open/extract, personal-profile, raw JS/CDP, or remote authority is introduced.
Exact-head live transfer tests, CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000079: Browser MCP/profile exposure may activate only after every intended browser shape is backed by a live qualified implementation.

done_when: Live downloads/uploads are canonically connected to Quntal's existing bounded transfer policy with no generic browser filesystem authority or execution path.
